inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a pro-life law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that the Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post, “This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right,” appeared on LifeNews.com.
